reason: My bookkeeper already runs everything through Jurnal and it works well enough. I'm not adding another tool and another monthly bill just so receipts land in a Google Sheet nobody reads but me.
objection: Will it really catch a duplicate when my cook sends the same nota twice from a different angle, or is it just a receipt-to-table bot? And a sheet sitting next to Jurnal means two records to keep straight.
would_change_my_mind: If it pushed straight into Jurnal and I saw it catch a real double-submitted receipt from my own chat history during the free trial.
